thread:
amy: Quick sync - follow-up on the recurring streaming/chat partial-response timeouts. Want a single place to lock ownership, timelines, and next-week checks.

josh: +1. We saw 3 regressions in the last 10 days, same pattern: long-tail tail-latency spike -> client reconnect -> truncated response.

vikram: I pulled traces. Root cause looks like a combination of: 1) idle keepalive drop on the LB, 2) client-side reconnect semantics creating duplicate partial streams, 3) our streaming buffer timeout (config) was too aggressive for some models.

amy: Thanks. Can we break into action items with owners + dates? I'll drive follow-up.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-78 created by amy, severity: P2.

lia: I can own the LB keepalive tuning. Plan: increase idle timeout from 60s -> 300s in canary region, monitor for 24h, then roll. Target: 2026-05-03.

josh: I will own client reconnect documentation + safe-reconnect pattern in SDKs. Tasks: add server-side idempotency token handling + update JS/Go SDK examples. ETA: 2026-04-27.

vikram: I'll own the server-side streaming buffer config. Proposed change: bump streaming idle_threshold to 120s, and add a dynamic backoff when partial output detected. I'll run integration tests against long-sequence workloads. ETA: 2026-04-29.

amy: Good. Also two parallel items: observability and CI-evals.

sara: I will add a Canary test in our E2E suite that simulates intermittent socket drops and asserts no truncated final token. I'll push a PR with the harness + metrics exports. ETA: 2026-04-25.

dave: Ops: add a dashboard and alert for "streaming.partial_end_metric" with rate > 0.5% over 5m and a correlating tail-latency spike. Also create a Pager duty rule to route to eng-runtime on sustained errors. ETA: 2026-04-24.

amy: Nice. Can we capture acceptance criteria for each?

lia: LB tuning acceptance: canary region shows reduced RST/FIN events and 0 truncated responses for 24h under replay.

josh: SDK acceptance: SDKs retry with idempotency token; server dedupes by token; docs + sample app updated. No increase in duplicate completions in 48h of traffic.

vikram: Buffer acceptance: no server-side buffer timeout triggered for synthetic long prompt tests; regression tests added to CI.

sara: E2E acceptance: the new harness reproduces previous failure with the old config and passes with new config; test annotated in CI.

dave: Observability acceptance: dashboard shows streaming.partial_end_metric and an alert fires in test where we inject faults.

amy: OK owners + ETAs noted. Let's add a weekly check-in for two weeks. I will run a summary in next Monday's all-hands ops sync.

ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-20 09:00 UTC: "streaming partial-response follow-ups check-in" (recurs weekly x2).

josh: Quick question — is there risk from increasing LB idle to 300s (connection exhaustion)? lia: we'll canary with smaller pool size and watch fd usage. If we get >80% socket use, we rollback.

vikram: Also adding a safety guard: server will emit a single final chunk with a trailing error token if stream closed unexpectedly, so clients can detect incomplete generations. I'll send proposal.

amy: Perfect. Can each owner paste their main PR/issue link in this thread when ready so we can track in the incident ticket?

lia: +1 — will post link once LB PR is open.

josh: SDK PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412 — includes idempotency token + examples.

vikram: Server PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/998 - buffer defaults and trailing-error token support. Feedback welcome.

sara: E2E harness PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/e2e-tests/pull/155 — includes socket-drop harness and assertion.

dave: Dashboard + alert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-monitoring/pull/67. Added runbook snippet.

amy: Great. I'll update incident INC-2026-78 with these links and set the owners. Next check-in here on 2026-04-20. Thanks all :thumbsup:

josh: Thanks — will validate SDK behavior in staging once server PR lands.

lia: Canary started in us-west-2. Posting metrics in #eng-sre when we have 1h of data.

ops-bot: Notification: canary rollout started for LB keepalive change in us-west-2 (canary_id: cny-78).

vikram: Note: adding a unit test for the trailing-error token to ensure parsers don't treat it as content.

amy: Closing loop: capture these as action items in the incident ticket and mark this thread as check-in channel. We can resolve when all acceptance criteria met + 1 week stability window.

dave: I'll run a post-change blameless review if we see any fallout.

amy: Thanks everyone.
